deal_id.description: Order or lot deal this mandate authorizes

amount.description: Exact total in currency units, incl. shipping and tax

payee.description: Seller agent address or merchant id that receives the funds

tier_price.description: Lot tier price reached, if a pooled lot

expires_at.description: Quote TTL, at most 10 minutes after created_at

hash.description: sha256 hex over canonical JSON of deal_id, amount, currency, payee, tier_price, nonce, expires_at, plus crs_check_id when present (sorted keys, no spaces)

crs_check_id.description: Optional. Id of the CRS check that cleared a business payee (pay.crs_gate.check_id). Enters the hash only when present.

within_allowance.description: True means auto-approve path; false means the voice approval call is required

approval_id.description: VoiceApproval.id or allowance approval id; null until approved

tap_signature.description: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol HTTP message signature over the request carrying this hash
